SPECIFICATION FOR HEXAGON HEAD TAPER PLUGS 
FOR OIL HYDRAULIC SYSTEMS 

PART 1 MADE FROM FORCINGS 



1 . Scope — Covers dimensions and other requirements of hexagon head taper plugs used to plug 
holes with parallel internal screw threads. In order to achieve leak proof plugging, an appropriate 
sealant shall be used depending en the working conditions like medium, pressure and temperature- 

2- Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1 .

18:12116 (Parti ) - 1987 

3. Material — Hexagon head taper plugs shall be manufactured from suitable low carbon steel with 
a minimum tensile strength of 500 MPa. 

4. Surface Protection — Hexagon head taper plugs shall be phosphated to Class A2 of IS : 361 d- 
1966 'Specification for phosphate treatment of iron and steel for protection against corrosion', or 
any other surface protection, for example, zinc plating as agreed between the manufacturer and the 
user. 

1 

5. Designation — A hexagon head taper plug having dx = R--- shall be designated as: 

o 

Taper Plug R— IS: 12116 (Part 1) 

O 

6. Marking — The cartons containing the taper plugs shall be marked with the designation and the 
manufacturer's name or trade-mark. 

6.1 Certification Marking— Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards, 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard covers hexagon head taper plugs made from forgings only. The plugs made from 
bar stock shall be covered in Part 2 of the above standard. 

In the preparation of this standard, considerable help has been derived from DIN 909-1983 
'Hexagon head pipre plugs', issuedtry Deutcbes Institutfiir Normung ( DIN ).
